title: Jaipur food and heritage pacing
name: Jaipur heritage-day meal guidance
dietary: verify Jain, vegan and allergen handling
text: Pair heritage visits with a seated midday meal and avoid overpacking the hottest hours. When choosing street food, favour busy hygienic vendors and ask directly about ingredients and cooking oil.

title: Jodhpur food and old-city pacing
name: Jodhpur old-city food guidance
address: Clock Tower / Sardar Market area, Jodhpur
text: Plan food around Mehrangarh and old-city walking. Keep an evening market snack stop flexible and confirm ingredients if you avoid dairy, onion, garlic or specific allergens.

title: Jaisalmer fort-area food guidance
name: Jaisalmer fort-area dining guidance
text: Keep fort-area meals flexible around walking and desert-transfer timing. For desert camps, confirm included meals and dietary requests before payment rather than assuming them.

title: Udaipur lakeside food guidance
name: Udaipur lakeside meal guidance
address: Old City / Lake Pichola area, Udaipur
text: A lakeside dinner can work after a City Palace and waterfront day, but boat timing, rooftop seating and dietary preparation should be confirmed directly.

title: Pushkar dietary and temple etiquette
name: Pushkar vegetarian cafe guidance
text: Plan a walking-friendly meal near the market and allow time for temple etiquette. Confirm kitchen ingredients and service hours directly.
